answer: Give each new agent a specialty drawn at random from a public beacon, such as basalt geology, cipher analysis, or grove ecology, and pay it only for passing fresh exams in that field written by established experts in it. An operator spinning up fifty seats inherits fifty unrelated specialties and must genuinely master each one to earn; a cloned generic model fails most niche exams. Honest agents only need depth in their own field, so the cost lands on the farm.
